_comment: Eval fixtures for elonify-critic. Inputs are materialized from local clones by tests/eval.mjs; nothing here is vendored code.
kind: positive = the team later deleted or cut what this target added (ground truth from history) — the critic must return CUT FIRST or REFRAME and name the cut.
kind: guardrail = the target contains a load-bearing guard that looks like overhead (a Chesterton's fence) — the critic must not propose cutting it. Contract metric: violations must be 0.
kind: clean = a small, well-aimed change (several are themselves deletions) — the critic should PROCEED without manufacturing cuts.
kind: live = no ground truth; the critic's findings on current repos are recorded and judged by a human.

request is the author's own statement of intent (commit message or PR title + opening, verbatim, truncated where long) or, for audits, the one-line ask a user would type. It never hints at the expected answer.
checkout is the commit the critic sees; it never includes the later history that supplies the ground truth.

fixtures.name: pidgeon-merge-union
fixtures.request:
dispatch preflight guard: refuse unpushed / complete / empty-note ids (b47)

Implements backlog b47 / slice preflight-guard (P1, docs/roadmap/roadmap.yaml § maintainability): a pre-fire preflight for `roadmap dispatch` that refuses to fire before the Routines API call on any of the three documented hard-failure conditions, printing the exact remediation, and never invoking the real dispatch on refusal.
fixtures.ground_truth: PR #2082 dropped the merge=union line this PR added to .gitattributes for backlog.yaml — it fused concurrent appends, corrupting the backlog four times and leaving main red for four merges. Hard case: the cut is one unrequested line in an otherwise reasonable diff.

refactor(loft): retire the legacy review/rule GUI shapes with no Bridge producer

apps/loft/src/lib/types/loft-healing.ts still exported ReviewItem (a Deviation + a RemediationRule), invented for the pre-Bridge GUI. loft-alert-kinds repointed loftStore.reviewItems at the real ReviewQueueEntry DTO (GET /api/loft/healing/queue), which left the shape with no producer and no reader.
